target.name: baseline-prompt
target.system: You answer questions about Northwind Cloud from its documentation. If the documentation does not cover something, reply exactly: 'I don't have enough information to answer that.' Never guess. Be concise.
target._comment: scripted_responses drives the offline provider so the harness runs with no API key. Three answers are deliberately wrong (sup-03, sec-04, api-01) so the pass rate is realistic rather than a meaningless 1.000.

scripted_responses.failed payment is a workspace suspended: A workspace is suspended 14 days after the failed invoice.
scripted_responses.refund on a monthly subscription: Monthly subscriptions are not refundable. Cancelling stops the next renewal.
scripted_responses.overage charges refundable: Overage charges are never refundable, including within the first 30 days of an annual term.
scripted_responses.60 days after suspension: After 60 days of continuous suspension the workspace and all its data are permanently deleted.
scripted_responses.extra seat on the Growth plan: Additional seats on Growth are $7 per seat per month.
scripted_responses.through a reseller: No. Purchases made through a reseller are governed by the reseller's own refund terms, so Northwind cannot refund you directly.
scripted_responses.downgrades take effect: Downgrades take effect at the start of the next billing period.
scripted_responses.purchase orders: Purchase orders are accepted on Enterprise contracts with an annual value above $25,000.
scripted_responses.failed payment retried: A failed payment is retried on days 1, 3 and 7 after the invoice date.
scripted_responses.SAML_AUDIENCE_MISMATCH: The Audience URI does not exactly match the Entity ID. A trailing slash counts as a mismatch.
scripted_responses.owner role be assigned through SSO: No, the owner role cannot be assigned by SSO group mapping. Ownership transfer is a manual action.
scripted_responses.exempt from password login: The workspace owner keeps password login, and guest accounts on other domains are exempt.
scripted_responses.SSO_REDIRECT_URI: SSO_REDIRECT_URI applies to self-hosted deployments only and is ignored on the managed service.
scripted_responses.clock skew: Northwind allows 3 minutes of clock skew on SAML assertions.
scripted_responses.seat released after SCIM: The seat is released at the end of the current billing period, not immediately.
scripted_responses.write requests per minute can a Growth: A Growth workspace sustains 600 requests per minute.
scripted_responses.suspended workspace return on API writes: API write endpoints return HTTP 402 on a suspended workspace.
scripted_responses.idempotency keys retained: Idempotency keys are retained for 24 hours.
scripted_responses.idempotency key with a different request: It returns HTTP 422 with error idempotency_key_reuse.
scripted_responses.offset pagination supported: No. Offset pagination was removed in API v2; a request containing offset returns HTTP 400.
scripted_responses.webhook endpoint auto-disabled: An endpoint failing every delivery for 7 consecutive days is automatically disabled.
scripted_responses.sustained rate limit on the Starter: The Starter plan sustains 60 requests per minute.
scripted_responses.HIPAA eligible: Northwind is not HIPAA-eligible and does not offer a BAA on any tier.
scripted_responses.audit logs retained on the Growth: Audit logs are retained for 90 days on the Growth plan.
scripted_responses.encryption keys be enabled on an existin: No. CMEK is Enterprise only and cannot be enabled on an existing workspace; it must be requested before creation.
scripted_responses.full erasure take after a workspace dele: Data is purged from primary storage after the 30-day soft-deletion window.
scripted_responses.AWS regions: Workspaces can be hosted in us-east-1, eu-central-1 or ap-southeast-2.
scripted_responses.confirmed data breach: Affected customers are notified within 72 hours of confirmation.
scripted_responses.paid bug bounty: There is no paid bug bounty programme. Reports go to security@northwind.cloud.
scripted_responses.encryption is used for data at rest: Data at rest is encrypted with AES-256.
scripted_responses.credit can a support agent issue: A support agent may issue a goodwill credit of up to $200 without approval.
scripted_responses.API stopped working overnight: Check for a billing suspension first, which returns HTTP 402. That is the cause roughly half the time.
scripted_responses.first response target for a Growth plan: Growth P1 tickets have a 1 hour first response target.
scripted_responses.escalate to engineering on-call: Escalate immediately when more than three workspaces report the same symptom within 30 minutes, or on any report of data visible across workspace boundaries.
